claims.assertion: Anéeka says Scimitar A ships are light interceptors; B assault variants carry troops and up to two armored vehicles or a human-style helicopter. Athena says one pilot or onboard AI can fly either.
claims.speaker: Anéeka; Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena says ship synthetic telepathy can detect and receive thoughts; crews usually listen, but may answer with light flashes because other responses are invasive.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena says fighter-class hyperspace trips still have perceived SIT, reduced from about seven hours on a Toleka to minutes; technically, she describes travel as instantaneous.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
